nodes.mandatory_action: Adequate controls must be implemented to ensure data integrity and confidentiality during and after data migration, and completeness must be verified.

nodes.text: External parties shall be subject to a relationship assessment (sometimes referred to as due diligence review) shall cover:

nodes.text: Contract requirements shall include non-disclosure agreements, sub-contracting, roles

nodes.mandatory_action: Contracts must include specific clauses related to non-disclosure, sub-contracting, roles, responsibilities, termination, and audit rights.

nodes.text: Risk assessment shall be conducted for determining the risks involved in granting access
nodes.mandatory_action: Conduct risk assessments to determine risks associated with granting access.

nodes.mandatory_action: Review confidentiality and non-disclosure agreements with third parties periodically and upon changes to service terms.

nodes.text: Access management for third parties including granting access, review of user access rights shall be periodically assessed and changed as applicable.
nodes.mandatory_action: Periodically assess and change access management for third parties, including granting access and reviewing user access rights.

nodes.mandatory_action: Identify external parties for internal control review periodically.

nodes.mandatory_action: Establish alternative arrangements for business continuity in case external parties are unavailable.

nodes.mandatory_action: Evaluate escrow arrangements for information systems source code and proprietary technologies.

nodes.mandatory_action: Implement recovery arrangements for information stored with outsource providers.

nodes.text: Alignment with the organization’s business continuity program.

nodes.text: Assets associated with information and information processing facilities should be identified and an inventory of these assets should be drawn up and maintained.
nodes.mandatory_action: Identify organizational assets and maintain an inventory of them.

nodes.text: The asset owner should ensure that assets are inventoried;
nodes.mandatory_action: Asset owners must ensure that all assets are inventoried.

nodes.mandatory_action: Asset owners must define and periodically review access restrictions and classifications for important assets.

nodes.mandatory_action: Surveillance systems must be implemented and monitored regularly in major areas.

nodes.mandatory_action: Implement entry controls to protect secure areas and restrict access to authorized personnel only.

nodes.mandatory_action: Regularly review and update access rights to secure areas, revoking them when necessary.

nodes.mandatory_action: Implement appropriate controls to manage calamities.

nodes.text: Mock drills shall be conducted periodically to test the effectiveness of the controls.
nodes.mandatory_action: Conduct mock drills periodically to test control effectiveness.

nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure unattended equipment has appropriate protection.

nodes.text: Secure computers or mobile devices from unauthorized use by a key lock or an equivalent control, e.g. password access, when not in use.
nodes.mandatory_action: Secure computers or mobile devices from unauthorized use when not in use.

nodes.mandatory_action: Adopt a clear desk and clear screen policy.

nodes.mandatory_action: The Organization must implement a risk management program for periodic information security risk assessments.

nodes.mandatory_action: Results from information security risk assessments must be used to establish Information Security Risk Management.

nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must formulate and implement a risk treatment plan.

nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must implement procedures and other controls to detect and respond to security incidents.

nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must identify failed and successful security breaches and incidents promptly.

nodes.mandatory_action: Results and actions must be communicated to concerned teams and the CISO must be consulted on improvement plans.

nodes.mandatory_action: Audit trails must be stored for a defined period and protected from tampering.

nodes.mandatory_action: Establish and protect secure development environments for the entire system development life-cycle.

nodes.text: The development, test and production environments need to be properly segregated, any exceptions to be signed off by the ISC.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure proper segregation of development, test, and production environments, with exceptions signed off by the ISC.

nodes.text: Access should be based on the principle of least privilege and “need to know” commensurate with the job responsibilities. Adequate segregation of duties needs to be enforced
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement access controls based on least privilege and enforce adequate segregation of duties.

nodes.text: The IT/Business team should review the activity of outsourced system development.
nodes.mandatory_action: Review the activity of outsourced system development by the IT/Business team.

nodes.text: Organization may obtain application integrity statements in writing from the application system vendors providing for reasonable level of assurance about the application being free of malware at the t
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must obtain application integrity statements from application system vendors.

nodes.text: All application systems to be tested during the implementation in a robust manner regarding functionality controls to ensure that they satisfy business policies/rules of the organization and regulator
nodes.mandatory_action: All application systems must undergo robust testing during implementation to ensure compliance with business policies and regulatory requirements.

nodes.text: Robust system based controls need to be built into the system and thereby reducing the reliance on any manual controls
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must build robust system-based controls to reduce reliance on manual controls.

nodes.text: All applications to be tested for security controls to check for known vulnerabilities initially and during major changes.
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must test all applications for security controls to identify known vulnerabilities initially and during major changes.

nodes.text: Before the system is live, there should be clarity on the audit trails and the specific fields that are required to be captured as part of audit trails and an audit trail or log monitoring process inc
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure clarity on audit trails and the specific fields to be captured before the system goes live, along with a monitoring process and responsible personnel.

nodes.text: Direct back-end updates to database should not be allowed except during exigencies, with a clear business need and after due authorization as per the relevant policy.
nodes.mandatory_action: Direct back-end updates to the database must be restricted except in exigent circumstances with proper authorization.

nodes.text: Applications should be configured to logout the users after a specific period of inactivity
nodes.mandatory_action: Applications must be configured to automatically log out users after a defined period of inactivity.

nodes.text: There should be suitable interface controls in place to prevent any unauthorized modification
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement interface controls to prevent unauthorized modifications.

nodes.text: Establish a suitable backup policy for the application
nodes.mandatory_action: A backup policy for the application must be established.

nodes.text: A well-functioning cyber security management program consistent with cyber resilience best practices should be in place and verified.
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must implement and verify a cyber security management program aligned with best practices.

nodes.text: a well-functioning cyber security management program consistent with cyber resilience best practices should be in place and verified through supervisory review.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish and verify a cyber security management program consistent with cyber resilience best practices.

nodes.text: Appropriate degree of IT controls shall be ensured for outsourced activities.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure appropriate IT controls for outsourced activities.

nodes.text: Protection from DDoS Vectors needs to be part of sourcing and monitoring.
nodes.mandatory_action: Include protection from DDoS vectors in sourcing and monitoring processes.

nodes.text: Appropriate access controls along with restriction based on least privileges roles should be part of application and access control design.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement appropriate access controls based on least privilege roles in application and access control design.

nodes.text: For critical systems cyber security monitoring is essential, as performing security events monitoring and or analytics would assist in detection and mitigation cyber incidents.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish cyber security monitoring for critical systems to assist in detection and mitigation of cyber incidents.

nodes.text: Incident response planning is of great importance.
nodes.mandatory_action: Develop and implement an incident response plan.

nodes.text: Resumption of services (if interrupted) should be achieved within a reasonable timeframe, depending on the impact of the incidents and the criticality of the service.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure resumption of services within a reasonable timeframe after an incident, based on impact and criticality.

nodes.text: Cyber security incidents which are critically affecting the business operations and large number of customers should be reported to IRDAI within a Maximum period of 48 hours, upon knowledge.
nodes.mandatory_action: Organizations must report critical cyber security incidents to IRDAI within 48 hours of knowledge.

nodes.text: Organizations must report information security incidents, where the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of critical information is potentially compromised, to the IRDAI and Cert-Fin.
nodes.mandatory_action: Organizations must report incidents affecting critical information to IRDAI and Cert-Fin.

nodes.text: Organizations must report information security incidents, where the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of critical information is potentially compromised, to the IRDAI and Cert-Fin with the r
nodes.mandatory_action: Organizations must report information security incidents within 48 hours of identification.

nodes.text: Organization shall develop baseline SCD based on OEM’s recommendations and industry best practices.
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must develop baseline Secure Configuration Documents (SCD) based on OEM recommendations and industry best practices.

nodes.text: SCD should be reviewed for currency on a periodic basis by Information Security Team.
nodes.mandatory_action: The Information Security Team must review the SCD for currency periodically.

nodes.text: The exceptions to configurations as recommended in SCDs owning to certain business requirements/limitations should be approved through formal exception process after adequate risk assessment.
nodes.mandatory_action: Exceptions to SCD configurations must be formally approved after a risk assessment.

nodes.text: The IT infrastructure should be subject to configuration review (vulnerability assessment/penetration tests) against defined SCDs on a periodic basis.
nodes.mandatory_action: The IT infrastructure must undergo periodic configuration reviews including vulnerability assessments and penetration tests.

nodes.text: Regular scheduled assessments, such as internal and external vulnerability scans should be conducted for the IT Infrastructure including but not limited to software, applications, server, network, dat
nodes.mandatory_action: Regular internal and external vulnerability scans must be conducted for the IT infrastructure.

nodes.text: All Internet facing applications shall undergo vulnerability assessments before deployment in the production environment.
nodes.mandatory_action: Conduct vulnerability assessments for all Internet facing applications before their deployment.

nodes.text: Organization’s IT infrastructure should be updated with the supported, tested and reasonably latest OS and database patches including security patches and upgradation patches.
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must update its IT infrastructure with the latest OS and database patches.

nodes.text: Impact analysis and testing shall be performed for the recommended new patches, before deploying those in production environment.
nodes.mandatory_action: Impact analysis and testing must be conducted for new patches before deployment.

nodes.text: For the patches causing adverse impact or non-availability of business applications, exception approval documents should be maintained for future reference and audit purpose.
nodes.mandatory_action: Exception approval documents must be maintained for patches causing adverse impact.

nodes.text: Patches for end-points may be tested in test environment before implementation on the user machines.
nodes.mandatory_action: Patches for end-points must be tested in a test environment before implementation.

nodes.text: Network shall be segmented into zones/subnets based on function and possibly location.
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must segment its network into zones/subnets based on function and possibly location.

nodes.text: All network devices should be HARDENED based on their respective secure configuration documents before being deployed in production.
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must harden all network devices based on secure configuration documents before deployment.

nodes.text: Logical position of firewall in network architecture should ensure that firewall is not bypassed.
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must ensure that the firewall's logical position in the network architecture prevents it from being bypassed.

nodes.text: Defence-in-depth through placement of IDS/IPS solution shall be implemented to further control the internet traffic passing through these networks.
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must implement a defence-in-depth strategy through the placement of IDS/IPS solutions to control internet traffic.

nodes.text: These solutions shall be regularly updated with current signatures / characteristics of threats.
nodes.mandatory_action: Regularly update security solutions with current threat signatures.

nodes.text: Remote access to organization’s network resources over an un-trusted network (Internet/Extranet) shall be integrated into the overall network security management.
nodes.mandatory_action: Integrate remote access into overall network security management.

nodes.text: Clocks of all relevant information processing systems within an organization or security domain shall be synchronized with an agreed accurate time source.
nodes.mandatory_action: Synchronize clocks of all relevant information processing systems with an accurate time source.

nodes.text: Routing controls should be implemented for networks to ensure that computer connections and information flows do not breach the access control system of the business applications.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement routing controls to protect access control systems.

nodes.text: There should be segregation of duties for approval and implementation of configurations for network devices.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure segregation of duties for network device configuration.

nodes.text: Adequate redundancy should be provided for network links and network devices.
nodes.mandatory_action: Provide adequate redundancy for network links and devices.

nodes.text: REDUNDANT NETWORK LINKS AND DEVICES SHOULD HAVE THE SAME LEVEL OF SECURITY AS THE PRIMARY LINKS.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure that redundant network links and devices have the same level of security as primary links.

nodes.text: All single points of failure within the organization network shall be identified and the risks in such a design shall be assessed.
nodes.mandatory_action: Identify all single points of failure in the network and assess the associated risks.

nodes.text: Where possible, failover technologies shall be in place to address network failure.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement failover technologies to address network failures where feasible.

nodes.text: Network diagram (including wireless network) shall be documented and kept up to date.
nodes.mandatory_action: Document and maintain an up-to-date network diagram, including wireless components.

nodes.text: Logs generated by critical network devices shall be collected and analyzed to identify threats and exceptions.
nodes.mandatory_action: Collect and analyze logs from critical network devices to identify threats and exceptions.

nodes.text: Network security shall be monitored through a Security Operations Centre (SOC) to provide immediate response to threats.
nodes.mandatory_action: Monitor network security through a Security Operations Centre (SOC) for immediate threat response.

nodes.text: Digital signatures/certificates shall be acquired from the Certificate Authority (CA) licensed by the Controller of Certifying Authorities (CCA) India.
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must acquire digital signatures/certificates from a licensed Certificate Authority.

nodes.text: Accountability / responsibility for management of master keys shall be formally assigned within the organization in case of internal CA.
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must formally assign accountability for master key management.

nodes.text: Key custodians must be made aware of their role and they shall formally acknowledge their obligations in administering the security of the keys.
nodes.mandatory_action: Key custodians must acknowledge their obligations regarding key security.

nodes.text: Master keys for symmetric key/asymmetric key pair generation must be secured in a manner such that no one individual party is privy to the entire master key, wherever applicable.
nodes.mandatory_action: Master keys must be secured to prevent any single individual from having full access.

nodes.text: Keys/asymmetric key pairs shall be changed whenever a compromise occurs (or thought to occur), and whenever a party who is privy to a key/the private key component of the key pair, leaves the organiza
nodes.mandatory_action: Keys must be changed upon compromise or personnel changes.

nodes.text: A formal process must exist to revoke symmetric keys/asymmetric key pairs in a timely and effective manner.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish a formal process for timely revocation of keys.

nodes.text: Revoked keys shall be destroyed.
nodes.mandatory_action: Revoked keys must be destroyed.

nodes.text: Key backup process shall enable key recovery, but should not compromise key confidentiality and integrity.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement a key backup process that ensures confidentiality and integrity.

nodes.text: Request for recovery of keys/key pairs shall be made via a formal process that includes approval from competent authority.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish a formal process for key recovery requests that includes competent authority approval.

nodes.text: Data encryption keys – symmetric/asymmetric keys used for encryption shall be available as long as any information protected (encrypted) by the keys needs to be decrypted.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure data encryption keys are retained as long as the encrypted information requires decryption.

nodes.text: A public key shall be available as long as any information signed with the associated private key is maintained.
nodes.mandatory_action: Retain the public key for as long as the signed information is maintained.

nodes.text: Master keys shall be available as long as there is a requirement to recreate derived keys in the future.
nodes.mandatory_action: Maintain master keys for the duration necessary to recreate derived keys.

nodes.text: Keys used to generate hash algorithms shall be available as long as there is a requirement to prove or otherwise the validity of a previously generated hash value.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure retention of keys used for hash generation as long as needed to validate hash values.

nodes.text: Organizations shall establish logging and monitoring capabilities to detect security events in timely manner.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish logging and monitoring capabilities for security events.

nodes.text: Security logs shall be enabled on all critical information assets.
nodes.mandatory_action: Enable security logs on all critical information assets.

nodes.text: Security Logs generated by different systems and devices shall be collected such that linking (correlating) events generated across these systems and devices is possible and should be maintained for a
nodes.mandatory_action: Collect and maintain security logs for a minimum of six months and ensure they can be correlated across systems.

nodes.text: Security logs shall be made available to the Law enforcement agencies, IRDAI and Cert-Fin as and when required.
nodes.mandatory_action: Make security logs available to law enforcement agencies and regulatory bodies upon request.

nodes.text: Logging shall be enabled to track critical system activities which shall include: User account management, Privileged user activities.
nodes.mandatory_action: Enable logging to track critical system activities including user account management and privileged user activities.

nodes.text: Logging shall be enabled to track critical system activities which shall include: User account management, Privileged user activities, Changes in OS configuration, Multiple authentication failures/sim
nodes.mandatory_action: Enable logging to track critical system activities as specified.

nodes.text: All information systems including application, operating system, database, network and security devices shall maintain time synchronization with a standard time device/ server (NTP) to provide an accu
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure all information systems maintain time synchronization with a standard time device/server.

nodes.text: Log Retention schedule should be compliant with Organization’s record retention policy.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish a log retention schedule that complies with the organization's record retention policy.

nodes.text: All the logs and logging facilities should be protected against tampering and unauthorized access.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement protections for logs and logging facilities against tampering and unauthorized access.

nodes.text: Monitoring reports should be published based on the management requirements.
nodes.mandatory_action: Publish monitoring reports according to management requirements.

nodes.text: Periodic review of logs and monitoring reports for adequacy and contents should be performed.
nodes.mandatory_action: Periodic reviews of logs and monitoring reports must be conducted for adequacy and contents.

nodes.text: Incidents reported should be closed within defined timelines.
nodes.mandatory_action: Reported incidents must be closed within defined timelines.

nodes.text: Policy, Procedures and Guidelines for information security and cyber security incident management shall be prepared and implemented to discover, record, response, escalate and prevent information secu
nodes.mandatory_action: Prepare and implement policies, procedures, and guidelines for incident management in information security and cyber security.

nodes.text: There should be a system in place to ensure information security events and weaknesses associated with the information assets are communicated and corrective actions are taken in a timely manner.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish a system to communicate information security events and weaknesses and ensure timely corrective actions.

nodes.text: An incident management process shall be established, documented, implemented and maintained by the organization.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish, document, implement, and maintain an incident management process.

nodes.text: Roles and responsibilities of all the stakeholders of the incident management process shall be defined.
nodes.mandatory_action: Define the roles and responsibilities of all stakeholders in the incident management process.

nodes.text: Incident management team shall be established to take all incident related decisions.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish an incident management team responsible for incident-related decisions.

nodes.text: A communication channel shall be set up with internal parties and external organizations (e.g., regulator, media, law enforcement, customers).
nodes.mandatory_action: Set up a communication channel with internal and external parties regarding incident management.

nodes.text: Monitoring system should be in place so that proactive action is taken to avoid security incidents and malfunctions.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement a monitoring system to proactively avoid security incidents and malfunctions.

nodes.text: The Information security and Cyber security incident classification criteria shall be documented.
nodes.mandatory_action: Document the incident classification criteria for information security and cyber security incidents.

nodes.text: A process to assess the root cause of the incident and identifying the corrective and preventive measures shall be defined.
nodes.mandatory_action: Define a process to assess the root cause of incidents and identify corrective and preventive measures.

nodes.text: For Incident and Cyber Crisis; a comprehensive cyber security response plan needs to be developed and referred.
nodes.mandatory_action: Develop and refer to a comprehensive cyber security response plan for incidents and cyber crises.

nodes.text: For Incident and Cyber Crisis; a comprehensive cyber crisis management plan (CCMP) needs to be developed and referred.
nodes.mandatory_action: Develop and refer to a comprehensive cyber crisis management plan (CCMP) for incidents and cyber crises.

nodes.text: The Organization will need to take effective measures to prevent cyber-attacks and to promptly detect any cyber-intrusions so as to respond / recover/ contain the fall out.
nodes.mandatory_action: Take effective measures to prevent cyber-attacks and promptly detect cyber-intrusions.

nodes.text: CERT-In/NCIIPC guidance may be referred by the organizations while formulating the CCMP.
nodes.mandatory_action: Refer to CERT-In/NCIIPC guidance while formulating the CCMP.

nodes.text: Deployment of suitable technology for incident reporting and guidelines and procedures for timely escalation and action incidents reported.
nodes.mandatory_action: Deploy suitable technology for incident reporting and establish guidelines and procedures for timely escalation and action.

nodes.text: The logging, classification, diagnosis and rectification procedures for incident management shall be laid out in detail.
nodes.mandatory_action: Detail the logging, classification, diagnosis, and rectification procedures for incident management.

nodes.text: Incidents, classified as High or Critical, should be reported to CISO, CIO, CRO and other relevant stakeholders including CERT-in & CERT-Fin.
nodes.mandatory_action: Report High or Critical incidents to the CISO, CIO, CRO, and relevant stakeholders including CERT-in & CERT-Fin.

nodes.text: Security incidents having noticeable impact on customer service, or requiring reporting of incidents to external entities, in terms of any legal, regulatory and / or statutory requirement should be re
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure that designated officials report security incidents impacting customer service or requiring external reporting as per legal, regulatory, or statutory requirements.

nodes.text: The incident monitoring system should have a procedure to monitor, measure and review the effectiveness of the controls deployed.
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must implement a procedure for monitoring, measuring, and reviewing the effectiveness of incident controls.

nodes.text: Policy, Standards, Procedures and Guidelines shall be developed to address the threats to endpoints in information system infrastructure and to prevent unauthorized access to endpoints.
nodes.mandatory_action: Develop policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines for endpoint security.

nodes.text: To ensure that endpoint has an updated (patched) operating system and anti-virus software has the latest virus definitions, etc.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure endpoints have updated operating systems and the latest anti-virus software definitions.

nodes.text: To ensure system configurations are accurate and do not compromise the security requirements.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure system configurations are accurate and secure.

nodes.text: To prevent unauthorized external users and network traffic from gaining access to network.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement measures to prevent unauthorized external access to the network.

nodes.text: To prevent unauthorized devices and other portable storage devices connecting to endpoint.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement controls to prevent unauthorized devices from connecting to endpoints.

nodes.text: To prevent/detect any unauthorized software on the endpoints.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement measures to prevent and detect unauthorized software on endpoints.

nodes.text: To address technical system and software vulnerabilities quickly and effectively.
nodes.mandatory_action: Address technical system and software vulnerabilities in a timely manner.

nodes.text: Build capability to quarantine systems / devices if found to be non-compliant or infected.
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish a capability to quarantine non-compliant or infected systems/devices.

nodes.text: User rights should be allocated based on the principle of least privilege in accordance with their business/functional requirements.
nodes.mandatory_action: Allocate user rights based on the principle of least privilege according to business needs.

nodes.text: Authentication mechanism for end points connecting from Organization WAN or external network shall be implemented to ensure entry of only authorized users.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement an authentication mechanism for endpoints connecting to the organization's network.

nodes.text: Organization should regularly review remote access approvals and revoke those that no longer have a compelling business justification.
nodes.mandatory_action: Regularly review and revoke remote access approvals without compelling business justification.

nodes.text: Organization should ensure appropriate and timely patching, updating and maintaining.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure timely patching, updating, and maintenance of systems.

nodes.text: Organization should ensure appropriate and timely patching, updating and maintaining
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must ensure appropriate and timely patching, updating, and maintaining of systems.

nodes.text: Encryption should be used to protect communications of critical data between the access device and the organization
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement encryption for communications of critical data between remote access devices and the organization.

nodes.text: VLANs, network segments, directories, and other techniques should be used to restrict remote access to authorized network areas and applications within the organization
nodes.mandatory_action: Use VLANs and other techniques to restrict remote access to authorized areas and applications.

nodes.text: Organization needs to establish a VPN/Appropriate Communication channel over the Internet to securely communicate data packets over this public infrastructure
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish a VPN or appropriate communication channel for secure data transmission over the Internet.

nodes.text: All endpoints/workstations owned by the organization shall be loaded with pre-approved licensed software
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure all endpoints/workstations are loaded with pre-approved licensed software.

nodes.text: All endpoints/workstations owned by the organization shall be loaded with pre-approved licensed software.
nodes.mandatory_action: All endpoints/workstations must have pre-approved licensed software installed.

nodes.text: Any unauthorized installation of non-standard software on the workstation for personal or official use should be prohibited.
nodes.mandatory_action: Unauthorized installation of non-standard software must be prohibited.

nodes.text: Appropriate controls shall be in place to control the risks arising out of usage of mobile storage devices such as USB’s, CD-ROMs, RW-CD, external hard drives, cameras, portable media players, card re
nodes.mandatory_action: Controls must be implemented to manage risks from mobile storage devices.

nodes.text: IT Support team should configure all endpoint devices as per the baseline secure configuration documents provided by Information Security Team.
nodes.mandatory_action: Endpoint devices must be configured according to baseline secure configuration documents.

nodes.text: Unlicensed or doubtful software/applications should not be installed.
nodes.mandatory_action: Installation of unlicensed or doubtful software/applications must be prohibited.

nodes.text: Whenever connecting to the LAN, it must be ensured that anti-virus agent is installed with latest signatures on the device.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure that anti-virus agents with the latest signatures are installed on devices connecting to the LAN.

nodes.text: Approved Policy, Procedures & Guidelines for Virtualization of the systems shall be in place, which will detail, at least, the following: Centralized Administration of virtualized systems, Provisionin
nodes.mandatory_action: Establish and document approved policies, procedures, and guidelines for virtualization systems.

nodes.text: Access Control shall be implemented and adequate process shall be in place to ensure no unauthorized virtual hosts or guests are created.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement access control measures to prevent unauthorized virtual hosts or guests.

nodes.text: Access from and to the host should be allowed through a firewall controls to restrict access to the necessary services only.
nodes.mandatory_action: Configure firewall controls to restrict access to necessary services only for the host.

nodes.text: Network Access for the host OS should be restricted to management services and if required, to storage.
nodes.mandatory_action: Restrict network access for the host OS to management services and storage as necessary.

nodes.text: Administrative access for management of virtual networks, virtual servers and back up should be segregated.
nodes.mandatory_action: Segregate administrative access for management of virtual networks, virtual servers, and backup.

nodes.text: Access to virtual environment management console should be through centralized administrative console with audit logging capability.
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure access to the virtual environment management console is through a centralized administrative console with audit logging capability.

nodes.text: Appropriate hardening shall be implemented to prevent unauthorized file sharing, time synchronization.
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement appropriate hardening to prevent unauthorized file sharing and time synchronization.

nodes.text: All unnecessary programs shall be uninstalled, and all unnecessary services should be disabled.
nodes.mandatory_action: Uninstall all unnecessary programs and disable all unnecessary services.

nodes.text: Host OS must be patched regularly and in a timely fashion to ensure that the host OS is protecting the system itself and guest OSs properly.
nodes.mandatory_action: Patch the host OS regularly and in a timely manner.

nodes.text: VMs shall be configured by default to disable connections to peripheral devices.
nodes.mandatory_action: Virtual machines must be configured to disable connections to peripheral devices by default.

nodes.text: File Sharing shall not be allowed between the host and the guest in order to keep the host OS files integrity.
nodes.mandatory_action: File sharing between the host and guest must be prohibited.

nodes.text: Virtual systems shall need to be regularly backed-up for error recovery and continuity of operations.
nodes.mandatory_action: Regular backups of virtual systems must be conducted for error recovery and operational continuity.

nodes.text: Appropriate mechanism for monitoring the operations between the host and the guest should be put in place to ensure no unauthorized operations or no malicious operations or no resource monopoly happen
nodes.mandatory_action: A monitoring mechanism must be implemented to oversee operations between the host and guest to prevent unauthorized or malicious activities.

nodes.text: Policy, Procedures & Guidelines shall be framed to provide direction for hosting the type of information, its criticality and the level of security controls to be adopted, on cloud or on any external
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must frame Policy, Procedures & Guidelines for cloud hosting security.

nodes.text: Records shall be hosted within India.
nodes.mandatory_action: All core business records must be hosted within India.

nodes.text: Approvals should be obtained by the organization from their respective senior management.
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must obtain senior management approvals for cloud hosting.

nodes.text: Business justification for considering inevitable to host the data and system in Cloud.
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must provide a business justification for cloud hosting.

nodes.text: An appropriate service level agreement shall be in place to address I. Sustainability, support for fail safe operations II. Data Retrieval time, protection of IPR, etc. III. Security control measures
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must establish a service level agreement that includes specified operational and security measures.

nodes.text: Service Provider’s contract shall include clauses to ensure confidentiality, integrity,
nodes.mandatory_action: Service Provider's contracts must include clauses ensuring confidentiality and integrity.

nodes.text: Contracts with service provider shall include but not limited to following in addition to the other contractual requirement: SLA, Compliance to applicable laws & regulations, Data ownership, Authentic
nodes.mandatory_action: Contracts with service providers must include specific requirements related to service level agreements, compliance, data ownership, and security controls.

nodes.text: Appropriate Access control mechanism shall be implemented with reliable authentication mechanism to ensure data is not shared accidentally with other customers on the cloud
nodes.mandatory_action: Implement appropriate access control mechanisms with reliable authentication to prevent accidental data sharing.

nodes.text: Logging and monitoring of privilege access shall be carried out
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must carry out logging and monitoring of privilege access.

nodes.text: Controls related to Operations Security shall be implemented for ensuring Secure Configuration, Application, OS, DB, Web Server, Back-up & Recovery, Change Management, Capacity & Demand Management, Pr
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must implement controls related to Operations Security for various security requirements on cloud.

nodes.text: D-in-transition cloud shall be in encrypted form, as appropriate to the information classification.
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that D-in-transition cloud is in encrypted form according to information classification.

nodes.text: The Encryption techniques shall be implemented for cloud data hosting like Data in Transit and Data-at-rest for PII.
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers must implement encryption techniques for cloud data hosting for Data in Transit and Data-at-rest for PII.

nodes.text: Data retention and destruction schedules should be defined by the organization
nodes.mandatory_action: Insurers should define data retention and destruction schedules.

nodes.text: Data retention and destruction schedules should be defined by the organization and service provider should be made responsible to destroy the data upon request, with special emphasis on destroying all
nodes.mandatory_action: The organization must define data retention and destruction schedules and ensure service providers are responsible for data destruction upon request.

nodes.text: The company should audit this practice, wherever applicable.
nodes.mandatory_action: The company must conduct audits of its information security practices as applicable.

nodes.text: Data retention controls should also ensure that the multiple copies of the data stored in different locations are also destroyed post the retention timeframe.
nodes.mandatory_action: Data retention controls must ensure the destruction of multiple copies of data after the retention timeframe.

nodes.text: Policy, Procedures and Guidelines shall be prepared and implemented to provide direction to the users of mobile computing so that corporate network remains secure.
nodes.mandatory_action: Prepare and implement Policy, Procedures and Guidelines for mobile computing users.

nodes.text: All employees, interns and externals using devices falling into the category 'mobile devices' such as mobile phones, smart phones, portable devices, etc. shall acknowledge the security policy and the
nodes.mandatory_action: Ensure all relevant personnel acknowledge the mobile security policy and associated procedures.

nodes.text: devices shall acknowledge the security policy and the associated procedures & guidelines before they are allowed to use organization’s network using mobile devices.
nodes.mandatory_action: Devices must acknowledge the security policy and associated procedures before network access.

nodes.text: An inventory should be maintained of mobile devices in use, either owned by the organization devices or BYOD, associating owner name and identity for network access control shall be made mandatory.
nodes.mandatory_action: An inventory of mobile devices must be maintained, associating owner name and identity for network access control.

nodes.text: IT department of the organization shall prepare a list of authorized applications and shall have a documented process on management of such a list.
nodes.mandatory_action: The IT department must prepare a list of authorized applications and document the management process.

nodes.text: This process shall cover the review mechanism for approved applications as well as approved devices/services on a periodic basis taking into account new devices/services.
nodes.mandatory_action: The management process must include a periodic review mechanism for approved applications and devices/services.

nodes.text: Appropriate authority shall be notified immediately on suspicion of a security incident, especially when a mobile device may have been lost or stolen
nodes.mandatory_action: Notify the appropriate authority immediately upon suspicion of a security incident.

nodes.text: Remote device wiping or blocking mechanism for all devices accessing Organization’s internal networks should be appropriately implemented to protect a data in case of

nodes.text: The Reinsurer shall indemnify the Ceding Insurer only for losses exceeding INR 25 Crores per loss occurrence, subject to the terms outlined in Clause 4.

nodes.mandatory_action: The Reinsurer must process claims reimbursements within 45 days of receiving complete documentation.

nodes.mandatory_action: The Ceding Company must cooperate in recovery efforts from third parties.

nodes.text: The Ceding Company shall provide immediate notification to the Reinsurer, including preliminary loss estimates and potential impact assessments.
nodes.mandatory_action: The Ceding Company must notify the Reinsurer of significant losses exceeding $1,000,000 immediately.

nodes.text: The Ceding Company shall provide the Reinsurer with detailed reports on a quarterly basis.
nodes.mandatory_action: The Ceding Company must provide quarterly detailed reports to the Reinsurer.

nodes.text: Premium Remittances: Due within 30 days of the end of each reporting period.

nodes.text: The Reinsurer reserves the right to audit the Ceding Company’s records to verify compliance with the terms of this agreement.

nodes.text: The Reinsurer shall provide at least 30 days' notice prior to conducting an audit.
nodes.mandatory_action: The Reinsurer must notify parties at least 30 days in advance of an audit.

nodes.text: Both parties agree to implement appropriate safeguards to protect the confidentiality and integrity of shared information.
nodes.mandatory_action: Both parties must implement appropriate safeguards for confidentiality and integrity of shared information.

nodes.text: The parties agree to utilize secure data exchange protocols, including encryption and secure file transfer methods, to ensure the confidentiality and integrity of data transmitted between them.
nodes.mandatory_action: The parties must utilize secure data exchange protocols, including encryption and secure file transfer methods.

nodes.text: Data breaches or security incidents affecting shared information must be reported immediately to the affected party, with remediation measures promptly implemented.

nodes.text: Breach of any material term or condition of this agreement, with failure to cure within 30 days of notice.

nodes.text: Coverage shall continue for policies in force as of the termination date, with claims handled in accordance with the terms of this agreement.

nodes.mandatory_action: The Reinsurer must ensure liability for claims from covered policies issued before termination.

nodes.mandatory_action: Renewal terms must be documented in writing and signed by both parties.

nodes.text: The parties agree not to disclose any information related to the proceedings except as required by law or to enforce an arbitration award.
nodes.mandatory_action: Parties must maintain confidentiality regarding arbitration and mediation proceedings.

nodes.text: Both parties agree to keep the terms of this agreement and any proprietary information confidential, except as required by law or regulatory authorities.
nodes.mandatory_action: Both parties must maintain the confidentiality of the agreement's terms and proprietary information unless legally required to disclose it.

nodes.text: Unauthorized disclosure of confidential information may result in termination of this agreement and potential legal action.
nodes.mandatory_action: Unauthorized disclosure of confidential information must be avoided to prevent termination of the agreement and legal consequences.

nodes.text: Any amendments to this agreement must be made in writing and signed by both parties.
nodes.mandatory_action: Amendments to the agreement must be documented in writing and signed by both parties.

nodes.text: Amendments shall specify the effective date and detail the modifications to existing terms and conditions.
nodes.mandatory_action: Amendments must include the effective date and details of modifications.

nodes.text: No oral modifications shall be valid or enforceable.
nodes.mandatory_action: Oral modifications to the agreement are not permitted.

nodes.text: All notices required under this agreement shall be delivered to the addresses specified above by registered mail or email with confirmation of receipt.
nodes.mandatory_action: Notices must be delivered by registered mail or email with confirmation of receipt.

nodes.text: Each party shall promptly update the other party with any changes to contact information.
nodes.mandatory_action: Parties must promptly update each other with changes to contact information.

nodes.text: Neither party may assign or transfer its rights or obligations under this agreement without the prior written consent of the other party.
nodes.mandatory_action: Parties must obtain prior written consent before assigning or transferring rights or obligations under the agreement.
